fit_against_record_wording.record_text: تحققت اني عند خدك قطنة وكنت اراني واحدا في المترجم اذا عرض المرموز فالحل جوهرا من ابن دنينير وان ذكرهم

verdict: consistent once the plaintext is read from the cipher: 85 letters on 86 signs (one margin mark surplus), 100% one letter per repeated shape; verse 2 ends من ابن دنينير او ابن دريهم (the two names of the 50r discussion), not وان ذكرهم; also حرك, قطرة, اوحدا, فانحل
notes: Rows 1-7 of image 0084_0103 (segmenter lines 1-7). By eye 12 + 11 + 12 + 13 + 12 + 12 + 14 = 86 signs (record 85 from the segmenter: 13,10,12,13,12,12,13). Verse 2 as enciphered: اذا عرض المرموز فانحل جوهرا من ابن دنينير او ابن دريهم - l.6-7 have ابن (with a small ٨ set over the compound ب), دنينير over the line end, then two-sign او, ابن again, and دريهم (Two Tt Sy Zg Lc, every letter on its established shape). This is exactly what the compiler and his correspondent argue about on 49v l.13 (ثم كتب هن لفظة او ...) and 50r (Ibn Dunaynir vs Ibn Durayhim). The clear text l.12 on the page has فالحل ... وان د.يهم; the cipher has فانحل (Sn = ن, as in all 10 ن). Verse 1: عند is followed (after the l.1 divider) by a compound margin mark M at the left edge, left unassigned (surplus; it could be a correction or a catch-mark), then حرك on l.2 (H Tt K6: H is the ح of تحققت, Tt is ر in all 9 ر); the clear text on l.10 also reads حرك or خرك, not خدك. The next word has a small ل-hook (the ق shape) written above the ΔΔ: ق inserted + ΔΔ + Tt (ر) + Zg (ه) = قطرة; the page has فطنة/قطنة. اوحدا (not واحدا) in the cipher (A8 So H Two A8) and on the page. ع has two shapes (Cu in عند, Lr in عرض); ل and م one shape each (Y4, Lc). Not checked: whether M is one or two marks (the worm hole cuts it).
